name: gtha-metro-map-creator-desktop
description: Desktop app, server setup wizard and deploy app for GTHA Metro Map Creator
author: Ding Ding Projects

scripts.dist:app: node scripts/prepare.mjs && electron-builder --config builder-app.json --win portable --publish never
scripts.dist:wizard: node scripts/prepare.mjs && electron-builder --config builder-wizard.json --win portable --publish never
scripts.dist:deploy: node scripts/prepare.mjs && electron-builder --config builder-deploy.json --win portable --publish never
scripts.dist: npm run dist:app && npm run dist:wizard && npm run dist:deploy
